definitions.meaning: to manage a film or a company is to be in charge of it, run it
to point someone along the correct route, as you would a lost tourist

explanation.surface: Advice to a leader: run things by guiding others.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard verb meanings: running an operation, and guiding someone along a route.

indicators.note: about means surrounding here, so the word for angry goes round the other piece

parts.note: angry means irate
rig is an outfit or costume, so dress means rig

explanation.surface: Someone is furious that their outfit has been soaked.
explanation.definitionFit: Watering land through channels or pipes makes it wet, a verb-for-verb synonym.

clue.text: Gymnastics exclusively seen outside in public

indicators.note: one word is seen on the outside of the other, so it wraps round it as a container

parts.note: exclusively means only
PE, physical education, is the school subject that covers gymnastics

explanation.surface: Gymnastics performed only out of doors, in front of everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in public means doing it without concealment, the same adverbial idea.

parts.note: reads like trouble starting a conversation, but it is about repeating the first sounds of words

explanation.surface: Someone finds it hard to get a conversation going.
explanation.definitionFit: A speech impediment where the opening sound of a word is repeated before it comes out.

indicators.note: make tells us to form a new word from the following letters, rearranging them

explanation.surface: An instruction to train a pet: make the cat sit still.
explanation.definitionFit: Something static is motionless, so it is a synonym of still as an adjective.

clue.text: Offer support and love to girl

parts.note: a prop is a support
love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O
Sal is a girl's name, short for Sally or Sarah

explanation.surface: Someone offers help and affection to a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A proposal is something put forward, an offer, especially of marriage.

clue.text: About to be trapped in quarrel — shame!

indicators.note: trapped in means held inside, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: a dispute is a quarrel
re means about or concerning, as in business letters

explanation.surface: Someone is about to be caught up in an argument, to their embarrassment.
explanation.definitionFit: Falling into disrepute means losing good standing, which is disgrace or shame.

definitions.meaning: the rear part of a ship

explanation.surface: Someone stops smiling in return.
explanation.definitionFit: Stern means grim-faced, and is also the nautical term for the rear end of a boat.

parts.note: to set like a jelly is to gel
to light a fire is to ignite it

explanation.surface: Instructions for detonating a strong explosive by lighting it.
explanation.definitionFit: Gelignite is a high explosive made from nitroglycerine, used in blasting.

definitions.meaning: a folding stepladder used when painting a room inside

explanation.surface: Precautions someone puts in place before redecorating the house.
explanation.definitionFit: Steps are actions taken towards a goal, and also a stepladder, the kit for painting ceilings.

definitions.meaning: to have something as a purpose

explanation.surface: Someone plans to get drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Mean is a verb for having a purpose and an adjective for being stingy.

clue.text: Set day out for regular date

indicators.note: out signals the letters are put out of order, rearranged

explanation.surface: Fixing a day to go out with one's regular partner.
explanation.definitionFit: A steady is a regular boyfriend or girlfriend, someone one dates consistently.

indicators.note: without in the old sense of outside, so one word goes round the other

parts.note: to excise is to cut out
er is the sound made while hesitating

explanation.surface: A training session trimmed so there is no dithering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' tempts the solver to remove letters, but it is the old sense of outside, a container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Physical exercise is a workout, a noun-for-noun synonym.

clue.text: The lowest acceptable price is a pound

definitions.meaning: at auction, the minimum bid the seller will take
an enclosure where animals are kept, like a protected area

explanation.surface: An auction note: the minimum price is set at one pound sterling.
explanation.definitionFit: A reserve is an auction's floor price, and also a protected enclosed area for animals.

clue.text: Late rising around this place — that's heavenly!

indicators.note: around means going round the outside of the other piece
in a down clue rising means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: taken as written
this place means here

explanation.surface: Getting up late in this spot feels like bliss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns the first word into ETAL, as down clues are read upwards; 'around' then puts it outside the place word.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethereal means delicate and otherworldly, like something from the heavens.

definitions.meaning: a glen is a narrow valley; the 's stands for is

explanation.surface: Glen, a man's name, is saying goodbye.
explanation.definitionFit: A vale is a valley, like a glen, and vale is Latin for farewell.

parts.note: sounds like a heap left by busy builders, but the workers are tiny insects

explanation.surface: A heap built up by hard-working labourers.
explanation.definitionFit: A mound of earth raised by worker ants building their nest.

clue.text: Any hitch may be attributable to this bulb going out

indicators.note: the shuffled letters of the first two words could be put down to the plant, a hint that they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A gardening mishap blamed on a bulb that has died off.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue playfully suggests a hitch is caused by the bulb, while the words 'Any hitch' are rearranged into it; 'going out' adds to the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: The hyacinth is a scented spring flower grown from a bulb.

clue.text: Mid-evening in days before Easter can be quite mild

indicators.note: in means placed inside the other piece

parts.note: Lent is the forty days before Easter

indicators.note: mid takes the middle part of evening, dropping its outer letters

explanation.surface: In the middle of an evening during Lent, the weather turns quite mild.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mid-' keeps the three central letters ENI of evening; 'in' sets them after the first letter of the forty-day fast.
explanation.definitionFit: Being lenient means being gentle and forgiving, so mild in manner.

indicators.note: a form of means the letters take a new shape, rearranged

explanation.surface: A type of string from ancient Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: Chenille is a velvety tufted yarn or cord used in trimming and embroidery.

clue.text: Thought it will turn up in time

indicators.note: in means placed inside the time word

parts.note: noon is a time of day

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means reading upwards, so backwards

explanation.surface: Someone thinks the item will reappear eventually.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will turn up' makes TI of 'it', placed 'in' NOON.
explanation.definitionFit: A notion is an idea or thought, a noun synonym.

clue.text: Exist to maintain a young scout

parts.note: to exist is to be
to aver is to maintain or assert

explanation.surface: Living up to the standard expected of a junior scout.
explanation.walkthrough: Beavers are the youngest section of the Scout movement in the UK, below Cubs.
explanation.definitionFit: A Beaver is a member of the youngest age group of the Scouts.

definitions.meaning: as in a ... crop or ... edition
in cricket, a ball bowled to rear up high at the batsman

explanation.surface: An oversized parcel that is causing problems.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the bowler delivers the ball; a short ball that rears up awkwardly is a bumper or bouncer.
explanation.definitionFit: Bumper means unusually large, and is also a cricket ball pitched short to bounce up nastily.

clue.text: Number of the French in uniform

indicators.note: in means placed inside the other piece

parts.note: uniform means even, level
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A count of the French people in uniform.
explanation.definitionFit: Eleven is a number, one more than ten.

clue.text: Beastly way for Caesar to address his killer

definitions.text: way for Caesar to address his killer
definitions.meaning: Et tu, ...? is Caesar's line to Brutus in Shakespeare, using the Latin vocative

explanation.surface: How the dying Caesar cruelly spoke to the man who stabbed him.
explanation.definitionFit: Brute as an adjective means savage or beastly, and Brute is Brutus addressed in Latin.

parts.note: looks like knocked over violently, but means dispatched by aeroplane

explanation.surface: Someone has been knocked off their feet.
explanation.definitionFit: Letters posted by air are carried on an aircraft, literally sent flying.

clue.text: Travel in colourless form of transport

indicators.note: in means placed inside the other piece

parts.note: wan means pale, colourless
to go is to travel

explanation.surface: Riding in a drab vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A wagon is a four-wheeled vehicle for carrying goods, a form of transport.

definitions.meaning: an account or bill still outstanding

explanation.surface: A worker feels anxious because their wages have not arrived.
explanation.definitionFit: Unsettled means unstable or uneasy, and an unsettled bill is one still owing.
